posts.text: Pete Alonso: “I believe in the Baseball Gods, and I honestly believe I’m here for a reason. I was always meant to be a Baltimore Oriole.”

posts.text: #BlueJays lose, 4-2. That’s it, that’s all. They are now officially eliminated.

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: MLB says Phillies can clinch a postseason berth tonight with a win AND a loss by either Arizona or San Diego. Got it?

reply_texts.text: They would be guaranteed to reach Friday ahead of both, and they are playing each other Friday-Sunday, so impossible for both to catch the Phillies.
reply_texts.author: johnlindros.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: I’ll be in the house for the (delayed) clincher!
reply_texts.author: maxellxlii.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: So they have a sub-magic number of one win? AZ and SD play each other the last 3 games so one of them is guaranteed to lose at least one game.
reply_texts.author: diggitydek.bsky.social

posts.jp: MLBルール：フィリーズは今夜の勝利AND Arizona或いはSanDiegoの敗北で上位進出決定。了解？

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: MLB’s all-time strikeout leaders: 8. Justin Verlander (3,554) 9. Max Scherzer (3,550) Verlander pitches Saturday, Scherzer might pitch Sunday in the #BlueJays final game on short rest...
posts.jp: MLB歴代三振王：8位Justin Verlander(3,554)、9位Max Scherzer(3,550)。土曜Verlander登板、日曜はScherzerが短い休息でブルージェイズ最終戦に登板の可能性💪

posts.author: Matt Gelb
posts.text: Go to bed. The Phillies will not clinch tonight. They went 0-for-12 with runners in scoring position.
posts.jp: 寝とけ。フィリーズは今夜優勝しない。得点圏で0-12だ。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: Pete Alonso on why he did this: "The people who have supported us, it’s not what they expected or wanted either. For people to still show up, come out to a doubleheader today, and really just show the true support, it’s special, and that should be recognized."
posts.jp: ピート・アロンソ「応援してくれてる人たちも期待と違う結果になってる。それでも来てくれて、ダブルヘッダーに足を運んでくれる。その応援は特別だし、認められるべき」

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Dansby Swanson shatters his bat but gets enough of the pitch for a 2-run single with the bases loaded to the tie the game in the 6th. Cubs had been 1-for-25 with RISP this series before that timely hit by Swanson.
posts.jp: Dansby Swansonがバットを折ったが、満塁で2ラン単打を打ち、6回に同点に。カブスはこのSwansonの好打まで得点圏で1-25だった。

posts.author: Meghan Montemurro
posts.text: Alex Bregman's face still looks gnarly, including a bloody left eye, but he hopes to play this weekend in Boston. Likely will DH initially when he does return. "Lucky that it hit where it hit and just a lot of gratitude because if it was about a few centimeters higher, could have been detrimental."
posts.jp: Alex Bergmanの顔はまだひどい状態で左目も出血中だが、週末ボストンでのプレー望む。復帰時はDHが濃厚。「数センチ高かったら危なかった。いろいろ感謝してる」
